A beautiful confident woman stands in a futuristic neon-lit studio, looking directly into the camera with a warm smile. She slowly blinks, tilts her head, and smiles as cinematic blue and purple lights illuminate her face. The camera smoothly dollies forward.

As the voice says "Congratulations...", holographic particles begin floating around her. She raises one hand, and glowing digital interfaces appear in the air, displaying abstract AI video timelines and motion graphics.

When the voice says "ComfyUI is now on the next level...", the environment transforms into a futuristic AI laboratory. Screens behind her come alive with colorful video previews, flowing nodes, glowing connections, and animated visual effects. She walks forward confidently while maintaining eye contact with the camera.

As the narration continues, she gestures toward floating holographic windows. One transforms into a cinematic text-to-video scene, another into an image-to-video animation, while a third shows video editing controls. The holograms smoothly orbit around her.

The camera circles around her in a dramatic cinematic move. Her hair naturally flows from a gentle breeze, realistic facial expressions, subtle blinking, confident smile, elegant body language, highly detailed skin, natural motion, realistic physics.

In the final scene she stops, looks directly into the camera, points toward the viewer with a playful smile, then gestures toward a glowing holographic title reading "MINIMAX H3". Bright energy particles explode softly behind her as the camera slowly zooms in. She gives a confident wink and the scene fades out with cinematic lighting.

Ultra realistic, cinematic camera movement, smooth transitions, natural human motion, expressive eyes, subtle facial animation, realistic hair physics, volumetric lighting, depth of field, high-quality motion, filmic color grading, futuristic atmosphere, masterpiece.
